notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2): a valid zip container without manifest.blobs also holds the zero-data entry blobs/sha256, which carries the DOS directory attribute (0x10) and whose name does not end with '/'. Only the final '/' makes a directory entry (§11.9 rule 4), so blobs/sha256 is a zero-byte file directly in blobs/, so blobs/ is present while no blob is listed, and the file is an extra blob file (§11.1, §11.7 rule 3): E_MANIFEST_BLOB at the blob step (9) (narrow review high-1). The Rust verifier called the entry a directory entry and accepted this zip before the fix.
